entry.title: Eddystone Lighthouse
entry.note: Mapped viewer anchor is preferred for map alignment; operator table discrepancy remains unresolved and is not silently labelled survey truth. The circular tower has no main plan axis. Visible modeled base meets the host sea-level review plane. This is a visual datum convention, not surveyed reef elevation, mean-high-water conversion, tide or bathymetry. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.
